title: linaria heterophylla subsp. stricta
intro: Linaria heterophylla subsp. stricta, commonly known as the strict-toothed toadflax, is a plant species known for its unique characteristics. This plant is said to have various health benefits, including the potential to lower blood sugar levels and reduce inflammation, although more research is needed to confirm these effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids and alkaloids, although more research is required to fully understand its chemical composition and potential uses.
